title: Caustic — Path Tracer Studio
description: A real progressive path tracer in a single file: build the scene, give it materials, pull focus, export the render.
concept: Caustic is a physically-based renderer you can drive with your thumbs. Spheres and room walls are traced with cosine-weighted diffuse bounces, Fresnel-correct glass, fuzzed metal and next-event estimation toward the ceiling panel and any emissive sphere, accumulated progressively in a float buffer that keeps converging while you work. Select anything to retune its material, slide it across the floor, rack focus with a real aperture, re-grade the frame you already have, and download the result as a PNG — or hand the whole scene to someone else as a link.
features: Five scene presets — Cornell box, glass IOR study, roughness row, open sky, neon room
Click to select any sphere, then switch it between diffuse / metal / glass / light and retune colour, roughness, IOR, emission and radius
Drag-to-move mode slides the selected sphere across the floor under the pointer
Depth of field with a real aperture plus focus-on-selection, and exposure / ACES / Reinhard grading applied at display time without restarting the render
Export the accumulated frame as a PNG, save the scene as .json, reload one, or copy a share link that carries the whole scene in the URL

interaction.mouse: Drag to orbit, wheel to dolly, shift-drag to pan the target
interaction.click: Click a sphere to select it; the Material tab then edits that sphere
interaction.touch: One finger orbits, two fingers pinch to dolly, tap to select
interaction.keyboard: Space pause/resume · R clear accumulation · A add sphere · E export PNG · Delete remove · 1–5 presets
